description: Disulfide register test by cysteine-ordinal anchoring, with the inter-cysteine spacing evidence that justifies the anchoring
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

SP="MVDCQKEACNLQSCIQRNQYNQGNCEKFVNDLLLCCKRWYDKNSLTGNEAPHTCPELKPLLRQLSSRNLT"
HS="MPQKDPCQKQACEIQKCLQANSYMESKCQAVIQELRKCCAQYPKGRSVVCSGFEKEEEENLTRKSASK"
SC="MSNPCQKEACAIQDCLLSHQYDDAKCAKVIDQLYICCSKFYNDNGKDSRSPCCPLPSLLELKMKQRKLTPGDS"

cys=lambda s:[i+1 for i,a in enumerate(s) if a=="C"]
cSP,cHS,cSC=cys(SP),cys(HS),cys(SC)
print("Cysteine positions")
print("  S. pombe cmc4  :",cSP,f"(n={len(cSP)})")
print("  H. sapiens CMC4:",cHS,f"(n={len(cHS)})")
print("  S. cerevisiae  :",cSC,f"(n={len(cSC)})")

print("\nJustification for ordinal anchoring: inter-cysteine gap pattern")
gaps=lambda c:[c[i+1]-c[i] for i in range(len(c)-1)]
gS,gH=gaps(cSP),gaps(cHS)
print(f"  Sp gaps: {gS}")
print(f"  Hs gaps: {gH}")
print(f"  identical for the first {sum(1 for a,b in zip(gS,gH) if a==b)}/{len(gS)} gaps; "
      f"differences only at the C-terminal gap ({gS[-1]} vs {gH[-1]})")
pairs=list(zip(cSP,cHS))
print(f"\n  Ordinal map (Sp -> Hs): {pairs}")
print(f"  constant offset for cys 1-6: {set(h-s for s,h in pairs[:6])}; cys 7 offset {pairs[6][1]-pairs[6][0]}")

hs_ss=[(7,38),(17,28),(39,50)]    # 1HP8 SSBOND records, experimental NMR
sp_pred=[(4,35),(14,25),(36,54)]  # AF-G2TRJ8-F1-v6, SG-SG < 3.0 A (this work, iteration 1)
h2s={h:s for s,h in pairs}; ordh={c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(cHS)}; ords={c:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(cSP)}
spset=[tuple(sorted(p)) for p in sp_pred]

print("\n"+"="*80)
print("Register test (cysteine-ordinal anchoring)")
print("="*80)
rows=[]
for a,b in hs_ss:
    ma,mb=h2s[a],h2s[b]; mapped=tuple(sorted((ma,mb)))
    rows.append(dict(human_1HP8_SSBOND=f"C{a}-C{b}", cys_ordinals=f"{ordh[a]}-{ordh[b]}",
                     implied_cmc4_pair=f"C{ma}-C{mb}",
                     predicted_in_cmc4_model="YES" if mapped in spset else "NO"))
reg=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(reg.to_string(index=False))
free_hs=[c for c in cHS if c not in {x for p in hs_ss for x in p}]
free_sp=[c for c in cSP if c not in {x for p in sp_pred for x in p}]
n=int((reg.predicted_in_cmc4_model=="YES").sum())
print(f"\n  Unpaired Cys, human (experimental 1HP8): C{free_hs[0]} (ordinal {ordh[free_hs[0]]})")
print(f"  Unpaired Cys, cmc4 (AlphaFold predicted): C{free_sp[0]} (ordinal {ords[free_sp[0]]})")
print(f"  Same ordinal position: {ordh[free_hs[0]]==ords[free_sp[0]]}")
print(f"\n  RESULT: {n}/3 experimental disulfides reproduced in the cmc4 model, in exact cysteine register.")
print("  The AlphaFold topology was computed independently of the 1HP8 records, so this is an")
print("  out-of-sample agreement, not a fit.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,4.5))
def draw(seq,y,label,ss,free,col):
    for k,aa in enumerate(seq):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((k,y),1,.8,fc="#b2182b" if aa=="C" else "#ededed",ec="w",lw=.4))
    ax.text(-1.5,y+.4,label,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9.5)
    for (a,b) in ss: ax.plot([a-.5,(a+b)/2-.5,b-.5],[y+.85,y+1.6,y+.85],color=col,lw=1.9)
    for c in free: ax.plot(c-.5,y-.32,marker="v",color="#f1a340",ms=10,mec="k",mew=.5)
draw(SP,0,"S. pombe cmc4\nAlphaFold AF-G2TRJ8-F1-v6",sp_pred,free_sp,"#2166ac")
draw(HS,-3.4,"H. sapiens CMC4 / p8MTCP1\n1HP8 experimental SSBOND",hs_ss,free_hs,"#1a9850")
for s,h in pairs: ax.plot([s-.5,h-.5],[-.22,-2.62],color="#aaaaaa",lw=.8,ls=":")
ax.set_xlim(-19,80); ax.set_ylim(-4.3,2.4); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("All three experimental human CMC4 disulfides are reproduced in the S. pombe cmc4 model,\n"
             "in exact cysteine register, and the unpaired thiol sits at the same ordinal position",fontsize=10.5)
ax.text(62,1.1,"red = cysteine\narc = disulfide\norange = free thiol\ndotted = ordinal match",
        fontsize=8.5,bbox=dict(fc="w",ec="#999999"))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
reg.to_csv("table_disulfide_register.csv",index=False); print("\n  wrote table_disulfide_register.csv")
